parameters.name: Accessibility
parameters.description:
The access type. Valid values:

- PUBLIC: All members in the current workspace can access the instance.
- PRIVATE: Only the creator can access the instance.

parameters.name: Creator
parameters.description: The Alibaba Cloud account UID of the workspace permission creator.

parameters.name: Option
parameters.description:
The optional configurations. Separate multiple configurations with commas (,). Valid values:
- ResourceEmpty: The resource is empty. The resource is empty if Resource is not specified.
- DisableRam: RAM authentication is not performed.

parameters.name: PermissionCode
parameters.description: The name of the permission, which is unique within a region. For more information about permissions, see [Appendix: Roles and permissions](~~2840449~~). For information about how to obtain the permission name, see [ListPermissions](~~449132~~).

parameters.name: WorkspaceId
parameters.description: The workspace ID. For information about how to obtain the workspace ID, see [ListWorkspaces](~~449124~~).
